project.name: Secure AI & Data Governance Control Plane
project.description: A Motia-orchestrated control plane that centralizes policy enforcement, routing, and audit for AI, data access, and tool usage across regulated enterprises.
objectives: Centralize policies for AI usage, data access, model routing, and tools
Provide deterministic, auditable flows for every AI and data operation
Enforce regulatory and data residency constraints
Abstract over multiple model providers and internal models with policy-aware routing
Integrate into existing identity, security, and data governance ecosystems

services.name: policy_management_service
responsibilities: Expose UI and API for policy authors
Validate and test policies before activation

services.name: governance_gateway_service
responsibilities: Act as proxy for AI and data access requests
Authenticate and enrich requests with identity and context
Call OPA to evaluate applicable policies
Route, transform, or block requests accordingly

services.name: model_tool_router_service
responsibilities: Map logical model names to physical endpoints
Select appropriate model/provider based on sensitivity, jurisdiction, and policy

services.name: context_filter_redaction_service
responsibilities: Apply PII/PHI/PCI redaction and field-level filtering
Enforce dataset and column-level access rules before model invocations

services.name: dataset_catalog_service
responsibilities: Maintain inventory of datasets, indexes, and tools with labels
Expose metadata to policies and UI
Ensure only approved assets are accessible per use case

services.name: audit_monitoring_service
responsibilities: Log all requests, decisions, routes, and data touches
Export events to SIEM and compliance reporting
Provide forensics and incident response views
